name: jonfunk21/proteusai
description: ProteusAI is a library for the machine learning driven engineering of proteins. The library enables workflows from protein structure prediction, prediction of mutational effects to protein ligand interactions powered by artificial intelligence.
score_rationale: A focused protein-engineering library with end-to-end ML workflows for mutational effects and related design tasks.
category: Protein Engineering / Directed Evolution — ML for protein design
